dct_description_sm: Mozambique administrative level 0-3 boundaries (COD-AB) dataset version 01. This dataset is structured into 3 levels: - Admin 1: 11 Province - Admin 2: 159 District - Admin 3: 411 Posto Dates associated with this dataset: - 24 March 2024: dataset reviewed for accuracy and completeness - 07 June 2019: valid for use by the humanitarian community - 20 October 1954: last edit to the dataset before publishing - 20 October 1954: boundaries created by the source Contributed by [OCHA Regional Office for Southern and Eastern Africa (ROSEA)](https://data.humdata.org/organization/ocha-rosea). Quality assured, configured, and published by [OCHA Field Information Services (FIS)](https://data.humdata.org/organization/ocha-fiss) and [HDX](https://data.humdata.org/organization/hdx). Part of the dataset: [Global Subnational Administrative Boundaries](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/cod-ab-global)
dct_publisher_sm: Mozambique Instituto Nacional de Estatistica (INE) and partners
